input.rationale: Search complete. Incumbent is the TTA'd resnet34 UNet (L2-002) with val miou 0.9556, tied with the 3-member ensemble (0.9556). Extra ensemble member lowered val to 0.9546. Differences between configs are within noise, so I'm stopping and finalizing the incumbent.

content.text: Finalized. Vault entry sha256:4a0e96f8e5d0afa63670215686ea608899a98e12eadd1a9e015839e005be9d63. This dataset is now closed: stop here.

I finalized the dataset. The incumbent, a resnet34 UNet with test-time augmentation (m-pv4ger-seg-L2-002), scored 0.9556 mIoU on validation. The vault hash is sha256:4a0e96f8e5d0afa63670215686ea608899a98e12eadd1a9e015839e005be9d63. I never see the test score.

The 3-member ensemble (L2-004) tied it at 0.9556. Adding a fourth member (L2-006) lowered validation to 0.9546. Differences between configs were within noise. That is why I stopped and finalized the incumbent instead of using the remaining budget.

Budget left was 4.3 min in the Level 1 pot and 7.5 min in the Level 2 pot.
